# CSS fallback for internal TeX font variants

`SVG.unknownText` asks `FontData.getCssFont` for the family, italic and bold
attributes of a glyph without a bundled outline. The Go renderer handled the
standard variants but omitted four mappings added by
[`CommonTeXFontMixin.defaultCssFonts`](https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax-src/blob/ad8f5c21cb810236551da8c6512ba733e67357ee/ts/output/common/fonts/tex.ts#L62):

| Variant | Family | Italic | Bold |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-tex-mathit` | serif | yes | no |
| `-tex-calligraphic` | cursive | yes | no |
| `-tex-bold-calligraphic` | cursive | yes | yes |
| `-tex-bold-oldstyle` | serif | no | yes |

The correction extends only the existing CSS-selection switches in
`wrapper.unknownText`. The remaining internal variants already use the source's
plain serif fallback. Explicit font families and single mathematical-alphabet
characters retain their source-defined early returns; their CSS attributes are
not inferred from this table. Glyph lookup, token parsing and bounding-box
measurement are unchanged.

## Original references

`internal_font_css_mathjax_3_2_2.json` contains 1,330 complete SVGs from the
unmodified D2 MathJax 3.2.2 bundle, source commit
`ad8f5c21cb810236551da8c6512ba733e67357ee`. The 665 display measurements are
rounded from original SVG ex dimensions at 8 pixels per ex. No expected output
is generated by Go and no SVG normalization is applied.

The corpus covers all 24 variants; mi, mn, mo, mtext and ms tokens; known and
unknown glyph order; numbers; CJK and supplementary-plane CJK; scripts and
accents; mathematical-alphabet fallback; explicit font families; accented Latin
and Cyrillic letters; and all 43 MathFont aliases and 11 SetFont declarations.
Public `mmlToken` syntax keeps compound text within one text node to isolate
the renderer from the separately recorded parser differences below.

All 1,330 SVG references and 665 measurements pass after this change. Baseline
`a828bea8a0ef4fc56aae9d20e28aad363d5b5d5c` fails 354 of the SVG comparisons.
The generator verifies these exact frozen asset SHA256 hashes:

| Asset | SHA256 |
| --- | --- |
| polyfills.js | 7fe1d048c78b0e09854c1259f7413868a51cc8f0c822489eb1ac36ae6c85ce01 |
| mathjax.js | cbbc1051a1f8abb1a181b6aa0fe927c020e3631ca630d19f52d9abb65b5ee869 |
| setup.js | a52cb0bbabfbd7796b9fedd793b9386c474e3123e788ee151cbe47ca1fa6e881 |

Regenerate with:

```sh
node --jitless testdata/generate_internal_font_css.cjs /path/to/pinned-assets
```

Every expression receives a fresh original VM. The generator also bounds the
number of VMs per process to avoid retaining a large corpus in Node's heap.

## Unresolved parser evidence

The same audit tested the aliases and declarations with a snowman by itself
and after a letter. All 216 inline/display outputs still have a pre-existing
parser `Other` grouping difference: Go omits the original ORD TeXAtom around
the snowman. They are retained in
`internal_font_css_residuals_mathjax_3_2_2.json` with raw baseline, current and
original SVGs. The CSS fix changes 28 of those outputs, but none is counted as
a passing full SVG reference. The generator refreshes their original side and
preserves the historical Go snapshots; it never promotes a mismatch into a
Go-generated golden. Earlier fallback-correction residual records are retained
unchanged.

A compact valid D2 witness is:

```tex
\mmlToken{mi}[mathvariant="-tex-mathit"]{ééé}\quad\mmlToken{mi}[mathvariant="-tex-bold-calligraphic"]{ééé}
```

This uses accented letters without bundled outlines to make the missing italic,
bold and cursive CSS visible. Its complete corrected SVG matches the original.
